tasks.title: Compression contract primitives (FilterLevel, Protocol, codec registry)
tasks.parallelism_notes: Blocking foundation. Module 1 freezes the ResultCompressor Protocol and CompressionOutcome; everything else codes against that contract. Serializing it avoids three parallel worktrees redefining the same types and a painful merge (spec Worktree Strategy, Phase 1).

tasks.title: TOML compressor manifest schema + multi-source CompressorRegistry
tasks.parallelism_notes: Owns config.py + registry.py + compressors.toml exclusively. Disjoint from TASK-1949 (codecs/json_compact.py), TASK-1950 (budget.py) and TASK-1954 (codecs/columnar.py). Only shared file is compression/__init__.py (export lines) — trivial merge.

tasks.title: `json_compact` codec (MINIMAL, lossless)
tasks.parallelism_notes: Owns codecs/json_compact.py exclusively. Depends only on the frozen contract from TASK-1947; disjoint from 1948, 1950 and 1954.

tasks.title: Latency budget router + circuit breaker
tasks.parallelism_notes: Owns budget.py exclusively (spec Module 5, worktree B). Consumed by TASK-1951 and TASK-1954 but shares no file with either; must be complete before the stage can route.

tasks.title: CompressionStage — gates, level resolution, codec dispatch, metrics
tasks.parallelism_notes: Join point: needs the registry, at least one real codec, and the budget router before it can be meaningfully implemented or tested. Sequential barrier between the parallel codec/registry work and the manager wiring.

tasks.title: Wire the stage into ToolManager.execute_tool() + extend AfterToolCallEvent
tasks.parallelism_notes: Touches manager.py — the hot path of every agent — plus the shared lifecycle events module. Must not run concurrently with TASK-1953, which reorders a branch in the same function. Spec warns to audit in-flight specs touching execute_tool() before starting.

tasks.title: Compression tee — working-memory escape hatch + error-branch reorder
tasks.parallelism_notes: Spec worktree A. Owns tee.py; also edits manager.py (error-branch reorder) and stage.py (tee callback), so it must NOT run concurrently with any other manager.py/stage.py task — but is disjoint from TASK-1954 (codecs/), TASK-1956 (live.py), TASK-1957 (report.py) and TASK-1961 (google/client.py), which can run alongside.

tasks.title: `columnar` codec — Python reference implementation
tasks.parallelism_notes: Spec worktree B. Owns codecs/columnar.py exclusively; depends only on the frozen contract, so it can start as soon as TASK-1947 merges and run alongside the entire 1948-1953 chain. Its test suite is the executable spec for the Rust path (TASK-1955).

tasks.title: Optional Rust parrot_codec extension + maturin python-source fix
tasks.parallelism_notes: Spec worktree B continuation. Owns the new Rust crate and the [tool.maturin] block; touches columnar.py (dispatch) and budget.py (rust_available), so it must not run concurrently with TASK-1954 or TASK-1959. Disjoint from everything else.

tasks.title: Route clients/live.py tool execution through the real pipeline
tasks.parallelism_notes: Spec worktree C. Owns clients/live.py exclusively — no file overlap with any other task in this feature.

tasks.title: Savings report (per-tool / per-session, rtk-gain equivalent)
tasks.parallelism_notes: Spec worktree C. Owns report.py exclusively. Lowest priority; can trail the rest without blocking anything except TASK-1962.

tasks.title: End-to-end integration suite
tasks.parallelism_notes: Join point: the five spec section-4 integration tests only pass once tee, columnar codec and the live route are all merged. Shares conftest.py with TASK-1954, so it runs after that task, not beside it.

tasks.title: Latency benchmark suite + threshold calibration
tasks.parallelism_notes: Owns test_benchmarks.py; may modify budget.py defaults if measurement contradicts them, so it must not run concurrently with TASK-1955 (which also touches budget.py). Otherwise independent — the G7/G9 acceptance criteria cannot be checked without it.

tasks.title: Documentation + changelog for the compression pipeline
tasks.parallelism_notes: Documentation only — touches docs/ and the changelog, no source files, so it never conflicts. Deliberately late in the graph because it must document what shipped, not what the spec proposed.

tasks.title: Demote Google client truncation to last line of defense
tasks.parallelism_notes: Owns clients/google/client.py exclusively — no file overlap with any other task in this feature.
